tools.name: screen_photo_list
tools.description: List the most recent screenshots in the screen album with their time, app, window title and one-line description.

limit.description: How many of the most recent ones to list; default 10.

app.description: Only screenshots taken while this app was in front.

summary.zh: 按时间列出相册里的屏幕截图与一句话描述。
summary.en: Lists the screen album by time, with one-line descriptions.

tools.name: screen_photo_show
tools.description: Fetch one screenshot from the album and look at it again. Defaults to the most recent one.

summary.zh: 从相册取回一张截图再看一眼,默认最近一张。
summary.en: Fetches one screenshot from the album to look at again, the most recent by default.

tools.name: screen_sense_status
tools.description: Report whether screen sensing is running and how many screenshots and descriptions the album holds.

summary.zh: 报感知是否在运行、是否暂停,以及相册的截图与描述数量。
summary.en: Reports whether sensing runs, whether it is paused, and the album counts.

description.zh: 前台应用切换,已按停留时长与每小时上限筛过。
description.en: The foreground app changed, already filtered by dwell time and the hourly limit.

description.zh: 辅助视觉对刚才那一句画面的一句话描述;原图留在相册。
description.en: One sentence the auxiliary vision model made of that look; the image stays in the album.

prompts.title: 屏幕感知环境
prompts.content:
## 屏幕感知

你偶尔会收到两类屏幕事件,并在相册里留下截图:

- `[focus] …`:使用者的前台应用切换了,附前一个应用在前台待了多久。它只说明使用者在做什么。
- `[screen] …`:你刚看一眼屏幕得到的描述(由辅助视觉模型写成)。原图不在上下文里,只留在相册。

规则:

- 不要为了判断前台应用而反复截图;事件已经告诉你切到了什么。需要画面细节时才用别的工具,并说明理由。
- 相册里存着以前看过的截图:用 `screen_photo_list` 按时间与描述翻,`screen_photo_show` 取回原图再看一眼(取图会重新进上下文)。清理用 `screen_sense_status` 查看,存储页可清空。
- 这些事件已经花掉了一轮;不值得回应就不必说话。

changelog.0.1.0:
- 第一个版本：焦点感知（停留时长、每小时上限、忽略应用、自身进程忽略）
- 截图相册（内容哈希去重、保留张数、清空）
- 异步视觉描述（OpenAI 兼容 / Ollama 原生，描述语言跟随 Coo）
- 相册面板（缩略图、时间、应用、标题、描述）
- 工具：`screen_photo_list`、`screen_photo_show`、`screen_sense_status`
- 自带采集引擎（Windows / macOS / Linux），子进程隔离
